label: main season
summary: Recommend cancellation by non-technical survey for sign-off. Three distinct first-hand sources report safe use for at least five years (24, 6 and 7 years); the survey team saw no contamination indicators on the paths and field edges it visited. There is no direct or first-hand indirect evidence, and the vague second-hand warning is accounted for by the safe-use reports. The national criteria are met.
flags: The survey team's observation covered paths and field edges, not necessarily every part of this 1 km² forest area; the safe-use reports are important to the cancellation basis.
The nearest recorded accident is within 1 km, but is not recorded inside this area; it does not trigger the inside-area clearance criterion.
The zone survey flag and survey priority are visit-planning information, not evidence about contamination.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
There is no direct evidence and no indirect evidence of class 1 to 4, and every item of weaker indirect evidence is explained by evidence of absence of class 1 to 4.
3 different reliable source(s) report at least 5 years of safe use (E2; E4; E5); the criteria need 2.
No past landmine accident is recorded inside the area.

E1.quote: people should keep away from the area because of mines, but could not say who had seen anything, or where.
E1.note: Second-hand, unattributed warning with no identified witness or location; it suggests possible contamination but does not confirm it.

E2.quote: she has walked the trail across the area to the school every year for the past 24 years, and has never found anything or heard of an accident there.
E2.note: First-hand report by a regular land user of 24 years of safe use; it supports absence and helps contextualize the vague warning.

E3.quote: The survey team walked the paths and field edges of the area and saw no items, signs, fencing or other marks of contamination.
E3.note: The team's own observation found no indicators along the paths and field edges it surveyed; this supports absence only for the areas observed.

E4.quote: We have hunted and fished along these streams for 6 years. Nobody has found anything, and nobody has been hurt.
E4.note: First-hand report of six years of safe use of the area by a person using it; supports absence and accounts for the nonspecific second-hand warning.

E5.quote: We have cut firewood and timber here for 7 years. Nobody has found anything, and nobody has been hurt.
E5.note: First-hand report of seven years of safe use of the area by a person using it; supports absence and accounts for the nonspecific second-hand warning.
